## Natural history notes

A medium-sized white heron characterized by a slender black bill, black legs, bright yellow feet, and delicate plumes during the breeding season. In Florida, the Snowy Egret is found in marshes, mangroves, ponds, lakes, swamps, tidal flats, estuaries, canals, and shallow coastal or inland wetlands. It feeds on small fish, shrimp, crabs, insects, frogs, and other aquatic prey, often actively stirring the water with its yellow feet or darting through the shallows to flush prey into striking range.
